title: Serial analysis of coronary artery disease progression by artificial intelligence assisted coronary computed tomography angiography: early clinical experience
summary: AI-assisted CCTA quantification across serial scans measured coronary plaque progression in an early clinical series; the longitudinal imaging result is descriptive and the article calls for prospective outcome studies.
organization: Clinical Faculty in Medicine/Cardiology; UCLA David Geffen School of Medicine
